title: Pure Psychic
summary: Pure Psychic Synchro and Fusion strategy, uniting classic LP-paying EARTH and LIGHT Psychic monsters with modern payoffs. The deck leverages Emergency Teleport, Serene Psychic Witch, and Overdrive Teleporter to summon Level 2 and Level 3 Psychic Tuners and non-Tuners directly from the Deck, translating rapid LP expenditure into an indestructible Psychic End Punisher and Ultimate Axon Kicker.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Emergency Teleport: Quick-Play Spell summoning any Level 3 or lower Psychic monster directly from hand or Deck without consuming the Normal Summon.
Overdrive Teleporter: Tribute Summon powerhouse paying 2000 LP to Special Summon two Level 3 Psychics straight from the Deck.
Serene Psychic Witch: Recruiter that banishes a Psychic monster from Deck upon destruction and summons it during the next Standby Phase.
Psychic Wheeleder & Psychic Tracker: Level 3 extenders that Special Summon themselves from hand when another Level 3 monster is present.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Activate Emergency Teleport to Special Summon Serene Psychic Witch or Psychic Commander from the Deck.
Normal Summon Silent Psychic Wizard or tribute summon Overdrive Teleporter using Brain Research Lab or your standard summon.
Pay 2000 LP with Overdrive Teleporter to Special Summon Psychic Wheeleder and Esper Girl from the Deck.
Synchro Summon Hyper Psychic Riser to lock down monster effects.
Trigger Psychic Wheeleder to destroy an opponent's monster with lower ATK than the Synchro Monster.
Tune remaining monsters into Level 11 boss Psychic End Punisher, which gains massive ATK and effect immunity due to your significantly lower LP.
Resolve Miracle Synchro Fusion using GY Synchro materials to summon Ultimate Axon Kicker.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Psychic End Punisher: Dominant Level 11 Synchro boss immune to activated effects while your LP are lower than or equal to the opponent's, banishing threats and gaining huge ATK.
Ultimate Axon Kicker: Level 10 Fusion boss immune to effect destruction, inflicting piercing damage and recovering LP on destruction.
Hyper Psychic Riser: Floodgate Synchro restricting monster attacks and activations.
Thought Ruler Archfiend & Overmind Archfiend: Classic high-level Synchro bosses providing targeting negation, LP gain, and mass GY revival.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Emergency Teleport: The premier Psychic Quick-Play starter that facilitates instant Synchro climbing.
Miracle Synchro Fusion: Fuses banished or GY materials into Ultimate Axon Kicker for minimal resource cost.
Psychic Feel Zone: Shuffles banished Psychic Tuners and non-Tuners into the GY to cheat out Psychic Synchros from the Extra Deck.
Brain Research Lab: Field Spell granting an additional Psychic Normal Summon each turn.

main: Overdrive Teleporter

Serene Psychic Witch
Core Level 3 EARTH Psychic recruiter: when destroyed on the field, banishes any Psychic monster with <= 2000 ATK from Deck and Special Summons it during the next Standby Phase!
Silent Psychic Wizard
Core Level 4 EARTH Psychic (1900 ATK): when Normal Summoned, banishes 1 Psychic from GY; when sent from field to GY, immediately Special Summons that banished Psychic monster!
Hushed Psychic Cleric
Core Level 3 EARTH Psychic (2100 DEF): sends 1 card from hand to GY to banish 1 Psychic from GY; when sent from field to GY, immediately Special Summons that banished Psychic monster!
Esper Girl
Level 2 EARTH Psychic Tuner: when Special Summoned from banishment, banishes the top card of Deck face-down; when sent from field to GY, adds that banished card to hand!
Psychic Wheeleder
Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Level 3 monster, and destroys 1 monster your opponent controls when used for a Synchro Summon!
Psychic Tracker
Level 3 EARTH Psychic non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Level 3 monster, and permanently gives a Synchro Monster summoned using it +600 ATK!
Psychic Commander
Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that pays up to 500 LP during damage calculation when a Psychic battles to reduce the opponent's monster's ATK/DEF by that amount.
Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
Level 3 LIGHT Psychic Tuner that doubles as a handtrap and a target for Emergency Teleport / Overdrive Teleporter.
Emergency Teleport
Special Summons Psychic Wheeleder, Psychic Tracker, Serene Psychic Witch, Hushed Psychic Cleric, or Esper Girl directly from your hand or Deck.
Psychic Feel Zone
Returns 1 banished Psychic Tuner and 1 banished Psychic non-Tuner to your GY to Special Summon a Psychic Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position!
Miracle Synchro Fusion
Banishes 1 Psychic Synchro Monster and 1 Psychic monster from field or GY to Fusion Summon the 2900 ATK piercing, indestructible boss Ultimate Axon Kicker!
Brain Research Lab
Field Spell that grants an extra Normal Summon of a Psychic monster each turn and lets you place Psychic Counters instead of paying LP to activate Psychic effects!
